Type the first few characters of a noun and see the article immediately. The app contains a dictionary with more than 73,000 nouns. Optionally, you can display the definition of the noun.

FAVORITES
To focus on problematic nouns, add them to your Favorites for later reference.

RULES
Although the articles seem quite random, they are not completely so. Learn several handy rules and guidelines for determining the articles.

GAME
Select/guess the articles of nouns presented in random order.You can also purchase the game with Favorites.
